## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 01.09.2026 - 05.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _silna salim_, 05.09.2026, 1/5: "The automatic renewal of my subscription has occurred, and I am currently unable to cancel it. This service does not align with my fitness preferences and has proven to be entirely unhelpful. A monthly payment has been automatically debited from my account. I cancelled your service within five minutes of the renewal. I require a full refund for this charge."
            2. _khaldonalsalami_, 01.09.2026, 1/5: "useless just want to cancel subscription"
            3. _Akash Mishra_, 03.09.2026, 4/5: "However, the customer service and help desk experience has fallen short of the high standards set by the app itself. When encountering technical questions, subscription management concerns, or account-specific dashboard issues, getting a clear, timely, and effective resolution can be frustrating. Often, responses feel slow or lack the specific context needed to resolve account-related hurdles smoothly."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      6 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 23.05.2026 - 03.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Jay Gardam_, 31.08.2026, 1/5: "app keeps crashing. only started yesterday. paid and now can't get in."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23.05.2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Kendall Buggs_, 02.09.2026, 2/5: "Ridiculously glitchy app. Pointless"
